name: Debug and resolve software errors and exceptions
description: Users asked for assistance in diagnosing and resolving specific errors, exceptions, or unexpected behaviors encountered while running software, using command-line tools, or configuring applications. The scope covered a wide range of technologies, including web frameworks, database queries, system-level operations, and specialized tools like penetration testing frameworks or geographic information systems.
